title: Condensable
summary: CONDENSABLE, adjective [See Condense.] Capable of being condensed; that may be compressed into a smaller compass, and into a more close, compact state; as, vapor is condensable

inlines.v: CONDENSABLE, adjective [See Condense.] Capable of being condensed; that may be compressed into a smaller compass, and into a more close, compact state; as, vapor is condensable
